name: Frame Macro
description: Record and replay inputs tick-for-tick, with a live frame counter and a click-gap overlay.

show-overlay.name: Show overlay
show-overlay.description: Frame counter, plus the click-gap histogram while recording or replaying.

show-gap-stats.name: Show click-gap histogram
show-gap-stats.description: How many inputs came 1, 2, 3, 4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-12, 13-16 or 17+ frames after the previous one.

presses-only.name: Gaps between presses only
presses-only.description: Off: gap between any two inputs (press or release). On: press to press only.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode while replaying
safe-mode.description: Completions during a replay are treated as test-mode runs, so they are not saved or submitted.
